squash_message:
feat(gallery): add Invoke Bindings and Concurrency Patterns examples

Invoke Bindings: interactive gallery example with mock executors for
all six binding types (REST, MCP, GraphQL, Script, Agent, Process).
Each sub-example shows the YAML invoke syntax and a simulated
execution trace with realistic responses.

Concurrency Patterns: interactive gallery example demonstrating
semaphore, channel, concurrent map, spawned task, correlation scope,
and deadline context using parallel structural steps.

Exports DefaultCorrelationScope from yaml-core orchestration index
and casehub-entry bundle. Syncs contributor guide sample count.

Closes #496, #497
